selector.rationale: HIV infection with a CD4 count <20 cells/µL and symptoms of fever, productive cough, and radiographic findings of reticulonodular interstitial infiltrates are most consistent with Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia

rejected.label: Toxoplasmosis
rejected.why: Toxoplasmosis is already diagnosed and treated, and the current symptoms are not consistent with toxoplasmosis

rejected.label: Bacterial pneumonia
rejected.why: The lack of response to empiric antibiotics and the presence of HIV infection with a low CD4 count make bacterial pneumonia less likely

rejected.label: Disseminated histoplasmosis
rejected.why: There is no specific evidence to support the diagnosis of disseminated histoplasmosis, such as positive fungal cultures or antigen tests

support_spans: HIV infection with a CD4 count <20 cells/µL
fever to 39.6 °C
a 1-day history of productive cough
Chest radiograph showed a new left upper lobe opacification with diffuse reticulonodular interstitial prominence
CT scan of the chest confirmed extensive reticulonodular interstitial infiltrates with focal consolidation in the left upper lobe
